about: Visual effect ids used by skills.effect/vfx/extra. Deadlock's particle systems (.vpcf) are never read or copied: visuals reuse Risk of Rain 2's own effect prefabs and materials (Addressables keys checked against the installed catalog.json) or are built by our own code in Unity (kind custom: plugin/Runtime/Vfx.cs, made to look like Deadlock). kind: tracer (bullet line muzzle->hit), impact (one-shot at a point, scaled by radius when scaleWithRadius), ghost (attached visual that follows a mod-simulated projectile), orb (RoR2 OrbManager lightning orb), trail (vanilla DamageTrail fire trail), attachment (a RoR2 NetworkedBodyAttachment put on the hero), ward (a RoR2 BuffWard placed on the ground), material (a RoR2 material our custom visuals are drawn with), custom (built by Vfx.cs; addressable none), none. prop: a Deadlock model the extractor reads from the player's install as a plain mesh (addressable = its vmdl path; extractor 1.5.0+), drawn by Vfx with our own materials; a prop that could not be read falls back to a simple shape. meshes / clips (props only, extractor 1.6.0+): the model's meshes to read (none = all) and the clips to read with its skeleton (none = a still mesh): Rat King's rat runs and leaps, his banner's sewer rises out of the ground. tint: a RoR2 prefab (tracer, impact) recoloured to this colour (#RRGGBB) as our own copy, registered as an effect of the mod (Fx.Prefab); its materials' colour ramps are redrawn in it (Seven's yellow Shock Rifle tracer), none = as RoR2 has it. texture: a Deadlock particle texture the extractor reads like an icon (addressable = its vtex path; no new extractor), drawn by Vfx with the Sprites/Default shader: Wraith's card suits (a 4 x 4 sheet: club, diamond, heart, spade across the top), her eye sigil, the Full Auto ring and her eye.

Flame Dash: flames licking around Infernus' legs while he dashes, and burning patches of ground fire along his path that last as long as the trail
Concussive Combustion: a fire glow and embers building on Infernus through the fuse, then a fireball, a racing ring of flame, smoke and a burning ground
Sleep Dagger in flight: a violet glow and trail that always shows, with or without the knife model

Dust Devil: a twisting column of sand around Mo, swirling dust, a ground dome at the damage radius and dust streaks flowing inward from the pull radius (loop); a burst of sand as it starts and ends (cast, end); a small sand puff on enemies it ticks (hit)

Tag Team: Krill (the little figure) flying in an arc with an orange trail to each enemy (hop), an orange ring, electric arcs, a flash and a splash ring where he lands (hit), a puff where he is thrown and returns (cast, end)
Mo's punch while Krill is away: a dust burst and an orange flash on each enemy hit

Rule, Ratannia!: a gold glint on the raised banner (cast), a gold streak behind him in the leap (loop), the slam: a dust ring, cracked ground, gold flash, heavy shake and rats bursting out of the ground across the outer ring (hit), Deadlock's banner and sewer planted for 8 s (banner)
Rat Swarm: a dark puff under the carrier as the rats pour out (cast); the rats themselves are the crowd (Runtime/RatCrowd.cs); a small blood-red nip on each bite (hit)

The bat: a pink slash arc along the swing (cast; the heavy last swing wider), on each hit stone shards and grit bursting off the enemy with a pink flash, a camera kick and Deadlock-style hit-stop (hit), the overhead's small crack in the ground (end)

Bashdown: dust lifting off the bat in the hop (cast), a pink streak and falling grit behind the dive (loop), the smash: a crater, a ring of rock spikes punching up out of the ground, boulder chunks that fly and bounce, cracks, a pink shock ring, a dust ring and a heavy shake (hit), the ground shockwave racing out as a ring of dust and stones (wave)

G.O.A.T. dodge: a burst of dust where he kicks off, thin pink horn trails along the dash (cast), stone chips off each enemy he gores (hit)

Aura of Suffering: a green electric field on the ground around him, its edge pulsing like a faulty heartbeat, growing with Pain; on every beat wavy green strikes burst out of his chest across the ground to the edge (creator's reference), small strikes between beats; thin red threads drawing health from every enemy inside
Pain: the barbed wire on his left arm crackles with electricity from 3 Pain (Pain Battery ready)

Shocking Reanimation: crackling lightning as the user rises, a bolt striking down at the peak, a ball of lightning bursting out to 30 m, then a 20 s crackle around them; Tesla and Ukulele arcs to enemies

Chapter's End: a glowing ghost-green spirit page bolt (a soft core with a trail of tumbling letters from Paige's own text atlas), the book flaring at the cover as it fires; a burst of letters and a green flash where it pierces an enemy

Bookwyrm: the book flares and pages swirl as she casts; the dragon graphic glows on the ground where the wyvern appears; Paige's own wyvern (paige_dragon, flying with its dragon_fly clip) rides the path as a see-through glowing green spirit, breathing a cone of green ghost fire onto the floor that leaves a burning trail of green flames, embers and the green text-streak scorch for 3 s

Rallying Charge and The Green Knight: Paige's own horse knight (paige_knight, galloping with its own clip) as see-through glowing green spirits, a row of 5 (R) or one giant (Q), each with a trail of green spirit mist and hoof sparks on the ground; the knight graphic flares as she reads; a burst of green light on every enemy trampled and a heal glow on allies
Plot Armor: a faint green glow and slowly circling letters around Paige while it is on
